measured_effect: Printed 4.3 s for a 1.2 ms warm no-op check whenever zsh ran blaze as the last command of a subshell/script.
root_cause: zsh optimizes the final command in a subshell via exec without fork, so pbi_start_tvsec inherits the parent subshell birth timestamp. Always use monotonic phases.in_main() for CLI closing timers.
tried: Printing wall duration in print::closing using Phases::since_process_start() (macOS pbi_start_tvsec).

measured_effect: Regressed rust-bin build from 18.4 s to 22.1 s and turned a cross-crate #[track_caller] closure into a stub.
root_cause: Per-wave Maker drops cross-wave reuse and LocalEnclosers::collect only walks same-crate declarers. Parallel export needs a persistent per-worker Maker plus cross-crate encloser propagation.
tried: Constructing a fresh Maker::of_start per parallel export wave in engine_export.rs.

class: A declaration of readiness that outlives the content it was made about.
measured_effect: one reverted commit and one build round
root_cause: A ready file lists paths, not contents, and a successor lane was not told its predecessor's list was still live.
tried: A lane that took over another lane's files inherited its ready list (/tmp/round2/ready/records.txt) without knowing: while it was mid-write the runner snapshotted `crates/hir-def/src/deps.rs` with `pub mod awaited;` and no `deps/awaited.rs`...

class: a peak measure with no attribution: a fix to the largest frame can leave the peak unmoved and nothing says why
measured_effect: most of a session, half of it waiting on tempo runs (each 8-10 min) to get one profile
root_cause: the Par hooks marked the solve's stretches but the CLI passed Serial, which recorded nothing; and the peak footprint (29 GB) has no row saying which frames or allocations held it at its peak
tried: tempo's cold check held a 2.32 GB crate scope frame (core) and the profile could only say 'a crate scope'.

measured_effect: Falsified by Amdahl decomposition: stripping 15.7 MB of binary size left blaze --version at 3.17 ms; /usr/bin/true is 1.81 ms and 784 KB blaze-fact-shim is ~2.2 ms.
root_cause: With LC_DYLD_CHAINED_FIXUPS, warm startup wall time is bounded by macOS fixed per-process spawn + ad-hoc dyld overhead (~2.2 ms floor) plus 1.2 ms in-main work; Wasmtime is only ~5-8 MB of the 64 MB binary and is never faulted on warm check.
tried: Hypothesizing that removing Wasmtime/Cranelift/Pulley from the blaze binary would push warm blaze check wall time below 2 ms on macOS.
